title: A critical health alarm's lifecycle and its escalation
source: Guillaume: an alarm is acknowledged, then treated, and finally closed, at the least; the procedures handle its escalation
lifecycle: raised: someone saw it (the crew, the medical panel); the test that exposes the person stops at its next verdict, and no procedure may expose them
acknowledged: someone says they have it in hand (who, when)
in treatment: what is being done for the person, by whom
closed: the person is safe, said by someone who has that authority (mcp.tools.authorise), with the resolution; only then may a test expose them again

acknowledgeWithinSeconds.note: not acknowledged by then: level 1, Mother calls the commander

escalateAfterSeconds.note: still not acknowledged by then: level 2, Mother calls all the crew and informs Ground

treatWithinSeconds.note: acknowledged and no treatment recorded by then: Mother reminds who acknowledged it, every this long
